episode_guid: Episode 13 - We Interview Sam Buckby of Buckby Electrical
episode_title: Episode 13 - We Interview Sam Buckby of Buckby Electrical

real_qa.q: What was Buckby Electrical featured on and how did that opportunity impact the business?
real_qa.r: Buckby Electrical was featured on The Block Glass House, a television show that was in its final weeks at the time of this interview. Sam was recommended by an architect and a local builder connected to the show hosts Shannon and Simon. The experience was one of the most enjoyable jobs for Sam due to the high level of trust the clients placed in his expertise, allowing for consultative work rather than strict directive-based projects. The job required working long hours, often until midnight, and demonstrated the trust and holistic service his team could deliver.
real_qa.requete: Buckby Electrical The Block Glass House

real_qa.q: How has Buckby Electrical grown and what are the company's core operating principles?
real_qa.r: Buckby Electrical was born in 2002 and has grown on simple principles: look after your staff, the environment, and your customers. The company operates predominantly in Geelong and surrounding areas, serving high-end residential clients with architectural homes and commercial projects up to about the million-dollar mark. Sam has maintained a broad skill set for himself and his staff to tackle any scenario clients present, creating a highly skilled and diverse team.

real_qa.q: What challenges arise when contractors follow strict project specifications rather than providing expert recommendations?
real_qa.r: When working under strict directives with 100-page specifications, contractors often see things that won't work or won't satisfy the customer, but lack the opportunity to fix them because they are bound by contract. Sam noted this frustration happens all too often over his 15+ years in the industry, and it can sometimes cost the customer in the end because they discover the solution is not what they actually wanted.
real_qa.requete: contractor strict specifications frustration customer cost

real_qa.q: What types of projects does Buckby Electrical primarily undertake in the Geelong region?
real_qa.r: Buckby Electrical serves predominantly high-end residential clients, including nice big architectural homes for builders they have worked with for a long time. The company also handles commercial projects up to about the million-dollar mark, normally locally but also in areas as far as Warrnambool and Melbourne.
real_qa.requete: Buckby Electrical residential commercial projects Geelong

guest.bio_context: Sam founded Buckby Electrical in 2002 and has been running his own business for nearly 12 years, with over 15 years of total experience in the electrical industry. The company operates predominantly in Geelong and surrounding areas, specializing in high-end residential and commercial projects. Sam has built Buckby Electrical on principles of looking after staff, the environment, and customers, creating a highly skilled and diverse team in an enjoyable and supportive environment.

real_quote: They put a lot of trust in us and we're able to deliver what we were really happy with and I think they were really happy with.
